matches.rationale: The ground truth concerns a foundational claim about Jacobian algebras lacking Ext-symmetry and generalized preprojective algebras not being Jacobian due to nilpotency relations not derived from the potential — a Section 2 methodological issue. Neither finding addresses this; finding 1 discusses an index-shift error in a determinantal module computation in §4.1, and finding 2 discusses a domain/arrow-direction issue in Definition 2.2's admissibility condition — both are distinct, specific technical claims unrelated to the Jacobian/Ext-symmetry mechanism described in the ground truth.

pred_verdicts.rationale: Detailed, Lean-verified claim about an index-shift error in the §4.1 determinantal module formula — a plausible genuine defect, but not the Jacobian/Ext-symmetry issue in ground truth.
Detailed, Lean-verified claim about a domain/arrow-direction inconsistency in Definition 2.2 — a plausible genuine defect, but unrelated to the ground truth's Jacobian algebra/Ext-symmetry mechanism.
